newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Commerce Ministry takes action against Kiwi Air.
newsitem.headline: NZ Commerce Ministry takes action against Kiwi Air.

text.p: The Commerce Ministry will take action against the management of budget airline Kiwi Air, which went into liquidation last September, ministry solicitor Adam Feeley said on Thursday.

"It has always been our expectation that if the investigation substantiated any of the concerns raised at the outset, then further action under the relevant legislation would be required," Feeley said in a statement.
"The outcome is that such action is warranted."

Feeley said the investigation had sought to establish whether any evidence of mismanagement of the airline existed, whether it had complied with the Companies Act, and whether there was evidence of criminal offending that may be required to be passed on to the relevant authorities.
He said further action in respect of all three of these issues was appropriate.
Feeley also confirmed that a report had been passed to the police arising from the ministry's investigation.
